title: A Escarpment for the Current
author: Juniper Underhill
blurb: Theo Reyes, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
